issue.title: [Bug] Codex 官方订阅下「272K 时压缩」未生效，单次输入已达 359K
issue.body:
## 问题描述

在 magpie 的「使用 → Agent → Codex → 长对话」中选择了「272K 时压缩」，但使用 **Codex 官方订阅（ChatGPT 登录，`openai` provider）** 的已有会话在输入上下文达到约 359K 后仍未自动压缩，日志里此前还出现过约 373K 的单次输入。

希望确认这项设置是否覆盖官方订阅路径；如果覆盖，目前表现与设置不一致；如果只覆盖 magpie 提供的模型，希望界面明确说明适用范围。

## 环境与设置

| 项目 | 值 |
| --- | --- |
| 系统 | macOS 27.0.1 |
| magpie | 0.1.1364 |
| Codex App | 26.1016.62342 |
| Agent 页显示的 Codex CLI | 0.164.0 |
| 受影响会话日志中的 CLI 版本 | 0.163.0-alpha.11.2（与当前 Agent 页不同，保留两个版本供排查） |
| 会话模型 | `gpt-6.1-sol` |
| 会话 provider | `openai` |
| 登录方式 | Codex 官方订阅，非第三方 API key |
| 长对话 | 「272K 时压缩」选中，「完整窗口」未选中 |
| Codex 后台压缩 | 关闭 |

## 实际证据

读取了受影响会话的两份本地 rollout JSONL，只摘录 token 统计，不包含对话正文或认证信息。

以下均为 **`token_count.info.last_token_usage` 的单次请求统计**，不是会话累计 `total_token_usage`：

| 日志时间（UTC） | input_tokens | output_tokens | total_tokens | model_context_window |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 2026-10-24 02:23:14.935 | 373054 | 153 | 373207 | 475000 |
| 2026-10-24 02:54:16.674 | 359236 | 113 | 359349 | 475000 |

- 两份 rollout 中均未发现 `compacted` 事件或名称含 `compact` 的事件。
- 当前 `~/.codex/config.toml` 未发现 `model_auto_compact_token_limit`、`model_context_window` 或 `model_catalog_json` 配置项。**这只是排查线索，不能单凭这一点断定根因。**
- magpie 设置截图显示的文案为「Codex 和 Claude Code 在 272K（非 Claude 的 [1m] 模型也是）或这里填的大小时压缩；完整窗口每轮更贵」，没有看到官方订阅不适用的说明。

## 可能相关的实现路径（待维护者确认）

核对当前 `main`：官方账号模型的窗口由 [`CodexNativeWindow`](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/main/internal/provider/codex_models.go#L560-L589) 处理；当 provider 未显式配置该模型窗口、且条目来自后端时，会返回“不覆盖”。[`codex_backend.go`](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/main/internal/gateway/codex_backend.go#L1711-L1725) 用这条路径处理官方模型条目。

这可能解释了为什么官方订阅会话仍使用 `475000` 的有效窗口，没有表现出全局「272K 时压缩」的效果。但这里只核对了当前 `main`，尚未证明与本机安装版本实现完全一致。

另：magpie 的 `compactAt` 缺省值本来就代表 272000，设置文件里没有此字段不应当视为保存失败。

## 复现路径

1. 接入 Codex，在 magpie Agent 页将「长对话」设为「272K 时压缩」。
2. 在 Codex App 中使用官方订阅的 `openai` / `gpt-6.1-sol` 会话。
3. 持续对话，使单次输入上下文超过 272000 tokens。
4. 观察自动压缩是否发生，并核对 rollout 中 `last_token_usage` 和 `compacted` 记录。

这是已有长会话的实际观察，尚未用全新会话独立复现；设置切换、应用重启与该会话创建的精确先后关系尚未确认。

## 预期

「272K 时压缩」应当在官方订阅路径上也按该阈值生效；如果设置需要重启、仅对新会话生效，或只适用于 magpie provider，请在设置处说明，并提供能够判断当前会话实际生效阈值的方式。

官方配置参考将 `model_auto_compact_token_limit` 定义为自动压缩历史的 token 阈值，未设置时使用模型默认值：[Codex Configuration Reference](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/config-file/config-reference)。

comments.body: Taking this. Direction verified with one correction: your `codex_backend.go` pointer is the right file but the line has drifted on current main (dd1e8822) — official-model entries keep their own `model_context_window`, so Codex computes auto-compaction against 475000 and never reaches the 272K threshold. Will re-locate the exact path on current main and check how the compact threshold is meant to reach Codex before changing anything; patch to follow on my fork.

确认是 magpie 没把「272K 时压缩」套到官方订阅的原生模型上。修复分支：https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/issue-batch-1024pm（commit [e9926d70](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/e9926d70)，基于 main dd1e8822）。

**根因**与你的定位一致：`codexModels` 把后端条目原样交给 Codex——`CodexNativeWindow` 只处理「用户在 codex provider 上单独设过的窗口」，而 Agent 页「长对话」那项（`settings.Compact`）只对 magpie 自己目录里的模型生效（codexcat 写条目时的 `min(Context, Compact)`）。于是 `gpt-6.1-sol` 带着 475000 交给 Codex，Codex 按自己目录里的窗口把自动压缩放在 ~95%×475K，「272K 时压缩」对官方订阅形同虚设，会话就跑到了 359K。

**修复**：原生条目在没有用户单独窗口时，同样被压到 `settings.Compact()`（272K 或你填的数），后端的窗口保留为 `max_context_window`——与 magpie 自有模型条目同形状；「完整窗口」不压；你在 provider 上单独设的窗口仍原样优先。另外列表 ETag 的 `~compact` 标记从「只有非 272K 才携带」改为始终携带：存量 Codex 的 `models_cache.json`（还是 475000）在升级后会因 tag 变化重取一次列表，新窗口随之生效。

**验证**：假后端给 475000 时——默认压到 272000（max 475000）、自定义 300000 生效、`FullContext` 不压、用户窗口 400000 优先，四条断言在旧代码上红（475000 原样透传，即你观察到的行为）、修复后绿（`TestCodexModelListNativeCompactedAtTheThreshold`）；provider / codexcat / agent 三包全绿。注意阈值是 Codex 按 `context_window` 自己算的，生效以它重取一次模型列表为前提（上面的 ETag 变化会驱动）。

<!-- Downgraded to a diagnosis: the 272K setting's delivery path (the model list
     magpie serves) never reaches the ChatGPT account's own entries by design
     (#674/#1385/#976), the reported numbers match Codex's own stock default, the
     value in play is magpie's default (a 272K pick is stored as CompactAt 0, so
     any red-line-respecting override cannot fire for it), and both remaining
     levers (rewording the setting, extending its scope) are the maintainer's
     product call. No patch. -->

Took this and traced it on `dd1e8822`. Your reading of the behavior is right, and your `codex_backend.go` pointer was the right neighborhood — the line has drifted: on current main that logic sits at `internal/gateway/codex_backend.go:1717-1728`. The short version: the setting's whole delivery path is the model list magpie serves a Codex that runs through magpie, and the ChatGPT account's own entries in that list deliberately keep the backend's window — so `gpt-6.1-sol` compacts against 475000 per Codex's own default, and 359K/373K never gets there. So the patch my take promised does not follow: every lever here is either already in place (below) or the maintainer's product call. Details.

## Where "272K" actually reaches Codex

- The stored setting is `settings.Compact()`: `CompactAt`, else `WorkingWindow` = 272000, 0 under Full window (`internal/settings/settings.go:1025,1046-1054`). You're right that the missing `compactAt` field is not a save failure: picking 272K is normalized back to 0, i.e. the default (`SetCompactAt`, `internal/provider/compact.go:227-229`; pinned by `TestSetCompactAt`, passing on `dd1e8822`).
- Delivery is the `context_window` field of the model list magpie hands Codex: for magpie's catalog models `CompactFor` (`internal/provider/compact.go:44-52`) turns the threshold — the default 272K included — into `context_window`, with the real window as `max_context_window` (`internal/codexcat/codexcat.go:694-713`; pinned by `TestCodexCatalogCompactAt`, passing). This only reaches a Codex that asks magpie for its list.
- The account's own entries in the same answer are stamped at `codex_backend.go:1717-1728`, and the only override applied there is a window the user set on the codex provider (`provider.CodexNativeWindow`, `internal/provider/codex_models.go:560-588`, #674 — "a model with none set keeps the backend's"). No compact threshold is applied to them. Two more design lines keep the official entries native: a Codex in failover-only mode "keeps to its own models" (`internal/agent/codex.go:914-929`, #1385), and compaction of Codex's own models relays as it came (#976). So the setting's scope today is the models magpie lists, consistently in four places — but the text doesn't say so: "Codex and Claude Code compact at 272K (non-Claude [1m] too) or the size typed" (`internal/gui/assets/index.html:443`, zh at `internal/gui/assets/i18n.js:1038`). Stating the scope is a fair ask; the wording is the maintainer's.

## Why that session compacted at nothing

A rollout recorded as provider `openai` was created on Codex's built-in provider (magpie's connection writes `model_provider = "magpie"`, `internal/agent/route.go:23`). Two shapes fit, and the numbers agree with both:

1. The session never asks magpie for a model list — the Codex App on its own login talks straight to the backend, and nothing in magpie's catalog path can reach it.
2. magpie's account failover is on: `openai_base_url` points at the gateway (`internal/agent/codex.go:850-913`) while the provider stays `openai` — then `/backend-api/codex/models` is magpie's (`internal/gateway/codex_backend.go:35,78-79`), but the official entries keep the backend's windows exactly as in (1). You can tell the shapes apart by `openai_base_url` in config.toml, or by magpie's models appearing in the picker.

Either way Codex runs its own default. In current codex-rs (`openai/codex` main `970111f6`, `codex-rs/protocol/src/openai_models.rs`, `auto_compact_token_limit()`), with no `model_auto_compact_token_limit` set, compaction triggers at 90% of the model's resolved context window, min the entry's own limit: 475000 × 0.9 = 427500. Your largest single-turn total (373,207) is below it — no compaction, no `compacted` event, stock behavior for that model, not a magpie fault. (Your session's CLI was an alpha; the exact constant may differ a little, but the numbers fit.)

## Why I didn't patch it

1. **Carry the threshold onto the official entries in the served list.** The value in play would be the default, and the settings can't tell "picked 272K" from "never touched" — both are `CompactAt` 0. Pushing magpie's default onto the account's own models would silently move every failover user's official models (475000 is OpenAI's own entry value for `gpt-6.1-sol`; most entries do say 272000, newer ones don't). #674's contract is explicit — "nothing else in it changes; a model with none set keeps the backend's" — and overriding it is a product decision I'd rather not make unilaterally. Explicit thresholds only (a typed size, or the provider's Compact-at — which today also reaches only magpie's models) would not fire for your 272K pick at all.
2. **Have the toggle write `model_auto_compact_token_limit` into config.toml.** That key is global — every model, every session, unrouted ones included — while the catalog path is per-model; and config.toml writes are the "Tuned for you" surface's job, with its own stash/undo (`internal/agent/tune.go:92`). Folding a global write into the Settings toggle silently is a scope change, not a missing line.

A patch taking road (1) is already up in this thread (skygunner's `fix/issue-batch-1024pm`, e9926d70): per its description, the threshold — the default 272K included — stamped onto the account's own entries when no user-set window exists, the backend's window kept as `max_context_window`, and the list tag always carried so cached lists refresh once. I have not reviewed the code; what the trace above says is what such a patch decides on everyone's behalf: the default, not a size the user typed, moves OpenAI's own entry values (475000 on `gpt-6.1-sol`) for every failover user who never touched the setting. Whether that trade is wanted is the maintainer's call.

## What works today, without a patch

- Session through magpie (connected, or failover): set the model's window on the codex provider (`codex/gpt-6.1-sol` 272000, or `codex/*`) — #674 puts it on the official entry (`context_window`, max raised to it) and Codex compacts at 90% of that (~245K).
- Session that never touches magpie: `model_auto_compact_token_limit = 272000` top-level in `~/.codex/config.toml` reaches it regardless of routing — by hand, or via the "Tuned for you" advice, which puts the key in and takes it back out.
- Or run those conversations on magpie's models, which the setting covers by default.

If the maintainer wants the scope moved — thresholds carried onto the account's own entries, or the setting's sub-text saying what it covers — I'm glad to build either behind a red test. Both are product calls, so I'm leaving them here rather than slipping a patch in.

@ggbdpq 感谢你先认领并完整追踪了这条路径。更正我上面把 e9926d70 当作确定性 bug 修复的表述：这实际涉及产品语义的改变，尚不应视为上游可直接采用的补丁。

现有 #674 约定：用户没有给官方 ChatGPT/Codex 模型单独设窗口时，模型列表保留后端原值（例：gpt-6.1-sol 的 475000）。我 fork 的 e9926d70 会把 `settings.Compact()` 的默认 272000 也应用到这些原生条目，把后端值留在 `max_context_window`。但 `CompactAt=0` 同时代表“从未碰过此选项”和“选择默认 272K”，因此这会**改变每个此前从未配置该选项的 failover 用户的默认行为**。这不是简单的漏传字段。另外，从不请求 Magpie 模型列表、直接连接官方的 Codex App 不受此补丁影响。

希望维护者明确选择产品方向：
- **A：保持 #674 语义**，官方原生模型默认窗口不动。对想使用 272K 的用户，指导其按模型设置窗口，或在 Codex 配置中设显式 `model_auto_compact_token_limit`。
- **B：扩展设置作用域**，让 Magpie 的默认/自定义“长对话”阈值也覆盖官方原生模型（即我 fork 的实验方案），并在 UI 文案中明确默认行为改变。
- **C：仅澄清设置文案**，明确现有阈值只管 Magpie 提供的模型，不改变官方模型默认行为。

在维护者决定之前，我保留 fork 实验提交，不请求直接 cherry-pick，也不会以它替换已有上游合同。此处只希望确认应采用哪一种行为；若选 A/C，不需合并该提交。再次感谢你指出这层合同。

@skygunner Thanks for the honest correction — that takes real discipline after shipping a working patch.

And yes, we've landed on the same conclusion. The `CompactAt` 0 ambiguity you describe is exactly why the diagnosis above declined to push the default onto the official entries — "the settings can't tell 'picked 272K' from 'never touched' — both are `CompactAt` 0" — and what would move is OpenAI's own entry value (475000 on `gpt-6.1-sol`), silently, for every failover user who never touched the setting.

On the three options:

- **A (keep #674 semantics)** is the conservative reading, and the explicit paths work today: the model's window on the codex provider (per model or `codex/*`), or a top-level `model_auto_compact_token_limit` in `~/.codex/config.toml`.
- **C (state the setting's scope in its text)** is worth doing under either A or B: it's the reporter's original secondary ask, it's the cheapest of the three, and B would need it even more since its whole point is a stated behavior change. It doesn't have to wait on the A/B decision.
- **B (extend the scope)** is a product-direction change rather than a missing field. If it's wanted, the prerequisite is making "default 272K" distinguishable from "never configured" — a tri-state setting or an explicit opt-in; it can't ride on the ambiguous default. And it wouldn't reach the direct-connection Codex App either, where the config.toml lever is the only one.

@yetone A or B is your call; C is compatible with both and is where I'd start. If A (or A+C), I'm glad to follow up with the small copy patch for the setting's scope.

## Summary The small copy patch for the setting's scope, as offered above: option C. The Long conversations line now says what its delivery path is — the threshold rides the model list magpie serves — so a reader can tell why a subscription's own models don't follow it. This states today's behavior as traced in the diagnosis above; it decides nothing. It stays true under A, and under B it is the first line to update, which is what a scope note is for. @yetone it doesn't wait on the A/B call, per the joint comment above. ## What changed One sentence, five places. Took this and traced it on `dd1e8822`. Your reading of the behavior is right, and your `codex_backend.go` pointer was the right neighborhood — the line has drifted: on current main that logic sits at `internal/gateway/codex_backend.go:1717-1728`. The short version: the setting's whole delivery path is the model list magpie serves a Codex that runs through magpie, and the ChatGPT account's own entries in that list deliberately keep the backend's window — so `gpt-6.1-sol` compacts against 475000 per Codex's own default, and 359K/373K never gets there. So the patch my take promised does not follow: every lever here is either already in place (below) or the maintainer's product call. Details.

## Where "272K" actually reaches Codex

- The stored setting is `settings.Compact()`: `CompactAt`, else `WorkingWindow` = 272000, 0 under Full window (`internal/settings/settings.go:1025,1046-1054`). You're right that the missing `compactAt` field is not a save failure: picking 272K is normalized back to 0, i.e. the default (`SetCompactAt`, `internal/provider/compact.go:227-229`; pinned by `TestSetCompactAt`, passing on `dd1e8822`).
- Delivery is the `context_window` field of the model list magpie hands Codex: for magpie's catalog models `CompactFor` (`internal/provider/compact.go:44-52`) turns the threshold — the default 272K included — into `context_window`, with the real window as `max_context_window` (`internal/codexcat/codexcat.go:694-713`; pinned by `TestCodexCatalogCompactAt`, passing). This only reaches a Codex that asks magpie for its list.
- The account's own entries in the same answer are stamped at `codex_backend.go:1717-1728`, and the only override applied there is a window the user set on the codex provider (`provider.CodexNativeWindow`, `internal/provider/codex_models.go:560-588`, #674 — "a model with none set keeps the backend's"). No compact threshold is applied to them. Two more design lines keep the official entries native: a Codex in failover-only mode "keeps to its own models" (`internal/agent/codex.go:914-929`, #1385), and compaction of Codex's own models relays as it came (#976). So the setting's scope today is the models magpie lists, consistently in four places — but the text doesn't say so: "Codex and Claude Code compact at 272K (non-Claude [1m] too) or the size typed" (`internal/gui/assets/index.html:443`, zh at `internal/gui/assets/i18n.js:1038`). Stating the scope is a fair ask; the wording is the maintainer's.

## Why that session compacted at nothing

A rollout recorded as provider `openai` was created on Codex's built-in provider (magpie's connection writes `model_provider = "magpie"`, `internal/agent/route.go:23`). Two shapes fit, and the numbers agree with both:

1. The session never asks magpie for a model list — the Codex App on its own login talks straight to the backend, and nothing in magpie's catalog path can reach it.
2. magpie's account failover is on: `openai_base_url` points at the gateway (`internal/agent/codex.go:850-913`) while the provider stays `openai` — then `/backend-api/codex/models` is magpie's (`internal/gateway/codex_backend.go:35,78-79`), but the official entries keep the backend's windows exactly as in (1). You can tell the shapes apart by `openai_base_url` in config.toml, or by magpie's models appearing in the picker.

Either way Codex runs its own default. In current codex-rs (`openai/codex` main `970111f6`, `codex-rs/protocol/src/openai_models.rs`, `auto_compact_token_limit()`), with no `model_auto_compact_token_limit` set, compaction triggers at 90% of the model's resolved context window, min the entry's own limit: 475000 × 0.9 = 427500. Your largest single-turn total (373,207) is below it — no compaction, no `compacted` event, stock behavior for that model, not a magpie fault. (Your session's CLI was an alpha; the exact constant may differ a little, but the numbers fit.)

## Why I didn't patch it

1. **Carry the threshold onto the official entries in the served list.** The value in play would be the default, and the settings can't tell "picked 272K" from "never touched" — both are `CompactAt` 0. Pushing magpie's default onto the account's own models would silently move every failover user's official models (475000 is OpenAI's own entry value for `gpt-6.1-sol`; most entries do say 272000, newer ones don't). #674's contract is explicit — "nothing else in it changes; a model with none set keeps the backend's" — and overriding it is a product decision I'd rather not make unilaterally. Explicit thresholds only (a typed size, or the provider's Compact-at — which today also reaches only magpie's models) would not fire for your 272K pick at all.
2. **Have the toggle write `model_auto_compact_token_limit` into config.toml.** That key is global — every model, every session, unrouted ones included — while the catalog path is per-model; and config.toml writes are the "Tuned for you" surface's job, with its own stash/undo (`internal/agent/tune.go:92`). Folding a global write into the Settings toggle silently is a scope change, not a missing line.

A patch taking road (1) is already up in this thread (skygunner's `fix/issue-batch-1024pm`, e9926d70): per its description, the threshold — the default 272K included — stamped onto the account's own entries when no user-set window exists, the backend's window kept as `max_context_window`, and the list tag always carried so cached lists refresh once. I have not reviewed the code; what the trace above says is what such a patch decides on everyone's behalf: the default, not a size the user typed, moves OpenAI's own entry values (475000 on `gpt-6.1-sol`) for every failover user who never touched the setting. Whether that trade is wanted is the maintainer's call.

## What works today, without a patch

- Session through magpie (connected, or failover): set the model's window on the codex provider (`codex/gpt-6.1-sol` 272000, or `codex/*`) — #674 puts it on the official entry (`context_window`, max raised to it) and Codex compacts at 90% of that (~245K).
- Session that never touches magpie: `model_auto_compact_token_limit = 272000` top-level in `~/.codex/config.toml` reaches it regardless of routing — by hand, or via the "Tuned for you" advice, which puts the key in and takes it back out.

issue.title: [Bug] Codex catalog: context_window gets the 272000 template value instead of the model's real context

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
Summary

When magpie wires Codex, the generated catalog (magpie-desktop-models.json) gives every non-native model context_window: 272000 while putting the model's real context in max_context_window. Codex reads context_window, so a 1M-context model is shown and used as 272K.

272000 is exactly the context of GPT-5.6-Luna — i.e. the OpenAI template value is being used as the default instead of the vendor's real number that magpie already knows (it writes that number into max_context_window).

Environment

  • magpie 0.1.1734, Windows 11 x64

  • Agent: Codex (ChatGPT desktop app, model_catalog_json = "magpie-desktop-models.json" in ~/.codex/config.toml)

  • Provider: OpenCode Go (opencode.ai), model opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash, routed through openai_base_url = http://127.0.0.1:3425/backend-api/codex

  • Observed 2026-10-28

What happens

Codex shows the model's context window as ~272K (with output reserved, ~258K usable) instead of the 1M the model actually has.

Expected

Codex should show/use 1,000,000 for opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash.

Evidence

1. magpie's own gateway reports the correct number

GET http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1/models:

 {"id":"opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash","context_length":1000000,"context_window":1000000,"max_input":1000000}
 {"id":"opencode-go/deepseek-v4-pro","context_length":1000000,"context_window":1000000,"max_input":1000000}

models.dev, which magpie also uses, agrees — [opencode-go] deepseek-v4.1-flash: limit={"context":1000000,"output":384000}.

2. The generated Codex catalog disagrees

From ~/.codex/magpie-desktop-models.json (generated by magpie, 32 models):

 {
   "slug": "opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash",
   "context_window": 272000,        // <- what Codex reads
   "max_context_window": 1000000    // <- the real value, but Codex does not use it
 }

3. The pattern is systematic — models without max_context_window get the right value

The rule is exact: if max_context_window is emitted, context_window loses its real value and becomes 272000; if it is not emitted, context_window keeps the correct vendor value.

Why 272000

272000 is GPT-5.6-Luna's context (GPT 5.6 Luna (≤ 272K tokens), see also the Go usage table). It looks like the Codex OpenAI template's default window is used as the fallback when a max_context_window is being computed, instead of the model's own limit.context that magpie already has (and correctly writes to max_context_window).

Impact

  • The agent's own context accounting (compaction thresholds, "context left" indicators, /context) is computed from context_window. A 1M model is treated as 272K: Codex compacts far earlier than it needs to, and the difference is invisible in the UI.

  • Users cannot fix it from magpie: magpie codex has no context field (model, effort, subagent, subagent_model, subagent_effort, memories, login), and there is no per-model context override in the provider editor.

  • Workaround users reach for is editing magpie-desktop-models.json, which magpie regenerates.

Suggested fix

When building the Codex catalog entry, take context_window from the model's real context (the same value already written to max_context_window / the vendor's /v1/models context_length), not from the OpenAI template default. max_context_window can stay as the ceiling; context_window should be the effective window.

Optionally: an explicit per-model context override in the provider editor would let users pin a value when a vendor reports one that is too conservative (and would let magpie- regen not fight such a pin).

Reproduction

  1. Add an OpenCode Go provider (opencode.ai/zen/go/v1) with a key.

  2. Set Codex's model to opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash.

  3. Open ~/.codex/magpie-desktop-models.json and read that entry: context_window = 272000 while max_context_window = 1000000.

  4. Codex shows ~272K for a 1M model.

Notes

  • Filed from a real setup; no crafted case. Verified by reading magpie's own /v1/models, models.dev, and the generated catalog on the same machine.

  • The same 272000 appears for the native gpt-6-luna, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-reserve, codex-auto-review rows too — with max_context_window 872000. If the template value is intentional for those, then the issue is only that it is also applied to routed (non-OpenAI) models that have a different real context.

issue.title: Codex auto-compaction fails in concurrent sessions after switching to a larger context model

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
### Summary
When running multiple Codex sessions concurrently with different models, switching the active model in Magpie updates context configurations globally. This raises the auto-compaction threshold across all sessions, causing sessions with smaller context windows (e.g. 500k) to never auto-compact even when exceeding 90–95% capacity.

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Start a Codex session with a 500k context model (e.g. GPT).
2. In Magpie UI/CLI, switch the active model to one with a 1M context window.
3. Open a second Codex session using the 1M model.
4. Continue working in both sessions simultaneously.

### Expected Behavior
The 500k session triggers auto-compaction around 90% (~450k tokens) to prevent context exhaustion.

### Actual Behavior
The 500k session reaches 95% (~475k tokens) without ever triggering auto-compaction.

### Likely Cause
Magpie updates `~/.codex/config.toml` / model catalog globally upon model switch rather than per session. Codex calculates `auto_compact_token_limit` based on `model_context_window * 0.9`. Once overwritten by the 1M model (threshold ~900k), the 500k session's 475k tokens are evaluated as under 50% capacity, preventing auto-compaction and risking upstream context overflow errors.

issue.title: [Bug/UX] 各 agent 内重复显示全局“长对话”，且压缩阈值的适用范围、覆盖来源和实际生效值难以确认

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## magpie version

实际运行：**0.1.3425-local.1**，基于 v0.1.3425 的本地构建。本文涉及的原生 Codex 目录合并、Claude agent 压缩设置分支与该上游版本一致。

另以公开 **v0.1.3593** 源码复核了下述关键路径；它是本次核查时 releases feed 的最新版本，尚未在我的机器部署或进行运行验收。

## Where / OS / Agent

- GUI → Agents → agent 设置弹窗。
- Windows 11 x64。
- Codex CLI 0.167.0；Codex Desktop 内置后端 0.167.0-alpha.3.2。
- Claude Code 2.1.322。
- 同时使用 ChatGPT 登录的原生 Codex 模型、Magpie 路由模型，以及中转提供的 Claude 模型。

## 问题概述

希望从 agent 页面明确设置“什么时候压缩”，但现在需要同时理解全局设置、agent 覆盖、供应商/模型覆盖、原生模型例外、客户端原有设置、模型目录刷新以及客户端内部预留量，才能判断实际行为。

最直接的 UI 问题是：**同一个全局“长对话”控件被放进多个 agent 的设置弹窗，下面又紧邻一个该 agent 自己的“长对话”控件。** 在 Claude Code 的设置弹窗中修改上方数值，会同时影响 Codex 等其他 agent。用户很容易把这个操作理解成只修改 Claude Code。

全局 300K 确实曾保存并同步到部分模型；问题并非简单的“保存失败”。同一次设置对原生 Codex、Claude 模型及其他模型的结果不同，而页面没有给出当前选中模型的最终策略及原因。

## 1. agent 弹窗中的全局项与独立项范围不清楚

复现：

1. 打开任一支持压缩设置的 agent 弹窗。
2. 在上方“Long conversations”输入 300K。
3. 检查 Magpie 设置：得到 `compactAt: 300000`，`agentCompacts` 仍为空。
4. 其他 agent 的模型目录也可能同步成 300K。
5. 下方“Long conversations in {agent}”才调用 `settings/agent-compact`，其中 `Every agent` 表示跟随全局。

源码：

- [app.js](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/v0.1.3593/internal/gui/assets/app.js)：`renderAgentPrefs` 的上方控件调用 `settings/full-context`，`openAgentPrefs` 将这个共享控件移入各 agent 弹窗。
- [agentcompact.js](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/v0.1.3593/internal/gui/assets/agentcompact.js)：下方独立控件调用 `settings/agent-compact`。

建议把全局项放在明确的公共设置位置；agent 弹窗只显示“继承全局 272K / 为该 agent 单独设置”。如果保留全局快捷编辑，应明确标示“修改将影响所有适用 agent”。

## 2. 原生 Codex 模型没有收到页面选择的独立压缩阈值

这里的“原生”指 **Codex 自己的 ChatGPT 登录模型，模型 id 没有中转或路由前缀**，不是指 Responses 协议。

同一个生成目录 `~/.codex/magpie-desktop-models.json` 中，我读到过如下结果：

| 条目 | context_window | auto_compact_token_limit |
|---|---:|---:|
| 原生 `gpt-6-luna` | 872000 | null / 未设置 |
| Magpie auto 路由模型 | 922000 | 300000（当时全局设置为 300K） |

全局恢复默认 272K 后，路由条目变为 272000，原生条目仍未设置该字段。Codex 配置中没有顶层 `model_context_window` 或 `model_auto_compact_token_limit` 覆盖。

原因见 [codex_backend.go](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/v0.1.3593/internal/gateway/codex_backend.go) 的 `codexMerged`：原生条目应用 `CodexNativeWindow`，但这个循环没有应用全局、agent 或供应商/模型的压缩阈值。Magpie 添加的条目走另一条目录生成路径。

这意味着“完整容量已同步”不代表“压缩阈值已同步”。在当前 Codex 中，普通自动压缩阈值取显式阈值和完整容量 90% 的较小者；原生条目没有显式值时会回到模型默认计算。例如 872K 的 90% 是 784.8K，远非页面上理解的 272K。

关联 #3440。若“原生模型保留上游默认”是刻意设计，请在 agent 页面明确显示当前原生模型不受此项控制，并提供显式覆盖入口；若用户已经明确选择该 agent 的数值，希望这份选择能传入原生目录。仅在供应商里再填一次阈值，也需要这条目录路径实际读取它才能起作用。

## 3. Claude 模型按名称被跳过，显式 agent 阈值也无法覆盖当前模型

当前使用中转提供的 `claude-fable-5-2[1m]`。在 [claude.go](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/v0.1.3593/internal/agent/claude.go) 中：

- `writeCompact` 只给非 `claudeModel` / 非 `ClaudeGroup` 模型采用 `ForAgent("claude")` 的默认阈值。
- `desktopPlan` 的对应分支跳过 Claude 模型和纯 Claude 路由组。

因此“Claude 模型保留自身策略”的例外，也包含中转里的 Claude 模型，而非只针对 Anthropic 官方直连。普通模型/供应商的显式覆盖又是另一种优先级，用户难以从 agent 页面判断。

关联 #5537。希望区分“未配置时尊重原生默认”与“用户已明确给该 agent 设置阈值”。后者若仍不适用，应直接说明受影响的模型及原因。

## 4. 客户端已有设置会被保留，但页面缺少有效值和覆盖来源

一次全局设为 300K 后，Claude Code 的实际文件同时存在：

```json
{
  "autoCompactWindow": 272000,
  "modelSettings": {
    "auto/example-gpt": { "autoCompactWindow": 300000 }
  }
}
```

上例路由名已替换。当前选中的中转 Claude 模型没有单独的 `autoCompactWindow`，所以仍采用顶层 272K。

顶层值的原始写入者未确认；当前 Magpie 的 `claude.compact_default` 所有权标记没有认领它。`defaultOurs` / `userTop` 逻辑会保留这个值，同时更新其管理的其他模型条目。这种保留用户设置的行为可以理解，但页面应显示“当前模型实际使用 272K，来源：Claude Code 用户级设置；Magpie 设置未覆盖”，并提供明确的接管/恢复继承操作。

这是配置来源与优先级问题，不应笼统解释为缓存。单纯重新生成目录也无法解释或消除所有覆盖。

## 5. “Compact at N”在不同客户端并不代表相同的实际触发点

按已安装客户端代码核对，以下是算法计算，未为本报告新跑大上下文请求：

- Claude Code 2.1.322：当前模型的输出预留为 20K，再扣 13K。`autoCompactWindow=272000` 对应普通触发点约 **239K**；300K 对应约 **267K**；要得到约 272K 的触发点，当前算法下需要约 305K。
- Codex 0.167：`min(auto_compact_token_limit, context_window × 90%)`。容量 922K、阈值 272K 时仍为 272K；若容量也被设为 272K，则阈值会被压到 244.8K。
- Codex 的可用容量 95% 和界面百分比的基线换算属于另外的统计口径，不应与普通压缩阈值混为一谈。

关联 #5110、#4319。希望 UI 明确它编辑的是“客户端窗口参数”还是“期望实际压缩触发点”，并显示已知的客户端换算及容量上限约束。

## 6. Codex 后台压缩默认值可能晚于普通压缩阈值

当前启用了 `features.async_compaction=true`，没有单独百分比，因而使用 Codex 默认 **完整容量的 65%**。

对于容量 922K、普通阈值 272K 的模型：后台启动位置约 **599.3K**，普通压缩却先在 272K 达到条件；Codex 在普通阈值已达到时还会跳过新后台任务。因此这个组合无法在 272K 前提前准备摘要。页面同时显示“272K 时压缩”和“后台压缩已开”，却不说明两者的先后关系。

关联 #2490。建议显示两种计算后的触发位置，并在后台启动点晚于普通阈值时提示其效果。

## 7. 显式 272K 与“未设置/默认”在存储中被合并

[compact.go](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/v0.1.3593/internal/provider/compact.go) 的 `SetCompactAt` 和 `SetAgentCompact` 将等于 `WorkingWindow` 的 272000 归一化为 0。

当不同路径对“默认”和“显式用户指定”采用不同规则时，这会让“明确选择 272K”和“没有选择，保留模型默认”难以区分。若继续保留原生模型例外，需要保留显式选择的语义，或用独立的策略字段表达。

## 期望的整体行为

希望有一处可解释、可核对的有效策略，而不需要用户手改多个客户端文件：

1. 全局设置与当前 agent 设置明确分开。
2. 显示当前模型的完整容量、普通压缩阈值、后台压缩启动点、最终来源及覆盖原因。
3. 模型/供应商/agent/全局的优先级清晰；原生模型例外和客户端自设值不适用时有明确提示。
